description: Local-first desktop workspace for AI coding agents, pairing an Electron shell with a Rust host core, a bundled agent runtime and installable plugins
notes: The portable build's own launcher is a self-extracting stub that unpacks to %TEMP% on every run; Scoop expands its payload into the app directory instead, so the app starts from there and writes nothing to %TEMP%.

PI-Desktop keeps all state outside the Scoop app directory: sessions, settings, providers, secrets, plugins, attachments and logs in %USERPROFILE%\.pi-desktop, and Electron's window state, local storage and plugin partitions in %APPDATA%\PI-Desktop. Scoop uninstall removes neither - delete both to clean up completely.

Both 'pi-desktop' and the Start Menu shortcut launch the app through the bundled pi-desktop.cmd wrapper, which sets PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_FILE so PI-Desktop takes its no-install update path: it offers updates and links to the release page instead of downloading PI-Desktop-Setup-<version>.exe into %LOCALAPPDATA%\@pi-desktopdesktop-updater and letting that NSIS installer put a second copy of the app outside Scoop on quit. Starting PI-Desktop.exe directly skips the wrapper and lets the in-app updater do exactly that, so update with 'scoop update pi-desktop'.
